site_meta.name: Oscar Pagani
site_meta.headline: Senior Software Engineer · Front-End & Full-Stack
site_meta.bio: Bay Area software engineer. Nearly two decades shipping web tools and consumer products across Yahoo!, Wells Fargo, Pixar Animation Studios, Trulia, and Zillow. Most of my work has been front-end and full-stack — React, TypeScript, Node.js — with a soft spot for internal tools and the people who use them.

resume_meta.summary:
San Francisco Bay Area · [paganio@yahoo.com](mailto:paganio@yahoo.com) · [linkedin.com/in/opagani](https://www.linkedin.com/in/opagani) · [github.com/opagani](https://github.com/opagani)

## Summary

Senior Software Engineer with deep front-end and full-stack experience across **Yahoo!**, **Wells Fargo**, **Pixar Animation Studios**, **Trulia**, and **Zillow**. Specialist in modern JavaScript ecosystems — React, TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL — with a record of leading initiatives, mentoring engineers, and shipping internal tools and consumer-facing products at scale. Strong cross-functional collaborator across product, design, and platform teams.

## Experience

### Senior Software Engineer · Zillow
*Aug 2016 – 2023 · San Francisco Bay Area*

Led front-end and full-stack engineering across Zillow Group's rentals product surface — **Zillow Rental Manager, Renter's Insurance, Payments, Applications, and Leases**.

- Designed and built a **landlord-facing admin tool from scratch** to surface policy status, reports, and operational data across the rentals platform.
- Architected the React front end with **TypeScript, React Query, and React Table**, and a **Node.js + GraphQL** API behind it.
- Mentored engineers and partnered with product, design, and platform teams to ship features and unblock cross-functional work.

**Stack:** React.js · TypeScript · Node.js · GraphQL · React Query · React Table

### Senior JavaScript Engineer · Trulia
*Dec 2014 – Jul 2016 · San Francisco Bay Area*

Owned development and maintenance of Trulia's rentals web pages and mobile web experiences.

- Led front-end development for an initiative that began as a hack-week project — surfacing rentals near transit stations — and shipped to production.
- Modernized the rentals stack with **React.js, ES6, and Webpack** ahead of these tools becoming industry-standard.

**Stack:** React.js · Node.js · ES6 · Webpack

### Front End Web Developer, Studio Tools · Pixar Animation Studios
*Oct 2011 – Oct 2014 · San Francisco Bay Area*

Built internal web tools used across every Pixar production, partnering directly with directors, producers, animators, and artists.

- Designed and shipped a **Content Management System** hosting videos, pictures, and assets for all of Pixar's active films.
- Built the front end in **JavaScript and Ext JS** and the back end in **Python**.
- Provided ongoing technical support to studio creatives across multiple departments.

**Stack:** JavaScript · Ext JS · Python

### Front End Web Developer · Wells Fargo
*2009 – 2011*

- Built bank-internal web applications using **JavaScript, HTML, and CSS**, layered on a custom framework on top of **YUI**.
- Created responsive web pages spanning multiple Wells Fargo applications.

**Stack:** JavaScript · HTML · CSS · YUI

### Software Engineer · Yahoo!
*2006 – 2009*

Front-end engineering across three flagship Yahoo! properties — **Yahoo! Answers**, **Yahoo! Video**, and the **online advertising team**.

- Built and maintained tools using **JavaScript, HTML, and CSS**.
- Integrated the Yahoo! **YUI library** across multiple applications.

**Stack:** JavaScript · HTML · CSS · YUI

## Education

- **Lewis & Clark College** — BS, Mathematics
- **San Francisco State University** — BS, Electrical Engineering

## Skills

**Languages:** TypeScript · JavaScript · Python · C++ · C · HTML5 · CSS

**Frameworks & libraries:** React.js · Node.js · GraphQL · React Query · React Table · Ext JS · YUI

**Practices:** Front-end architecture · Full-stack development · Mentoring · Cross-functional collaboration

## Languages

- **Spanish** — native / bilingual
- **Italian** — professional working proficiency
